findings.location: Paragraph listing other hymns by Lowell Mason
findings.source_quote: Other hymns by Mason include “From Greenland’s Icy Mountains”, “When I Survey the Wondrous Cross”, “A Charge to Keep I Have”, “Joy to the World”, “My Faith Looks Up to Thee”, and “O Day of Rest and Gladness”.
findings.suggested_fix: These are quoted hymn titles (substantive prose). For fidelity, translate the titles into Spanish or provide conventional Spanish titles used in hymnals, keeping the original authorship attribution. Suggested translations (publishers may adjust to preferred established titles): «Desde los montes helados de Groenlandia», «Al contemplar la cruz maravillosa», «Un encargo que debo custodiar», «Gozo al mundo», «Mi fe mira hacia Ti», «Oh día de descanso y gozo». Alternatively, if this publication prefers to keep well-known English titles for recognition, mark them as titles but be aware this leaves substantive English quoted prose.
findings.translation_quote: Otros himnos de Mason incluyen “From Greenland’s Icy Mountains”, “When I Survey the Wondrous Cross”, “A Charge to Keep I Have”, “Joy to the World”, “My Faith Looks Up to Thee”, y “O Day of Rest and Gladness”.
